title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E05 — Celebrity Sex
A woman starts a high-end escort agency; a woman returns home from college to find a reality star living in her parents' home.

title: Not So Perfect Stranger
description: After a traumatic divorce, a young and promising architect returns to Niagara Falls to confront her nightmares. She soon becomes the target of a disturbed local whose dark history and obsession threatens both of their lives.

title: A Stranger at the Door
description: A couple's (Linda Purl, Perry King) adopted son returns home with evil intentions after many years away.

title: The Woman With My Face
description: When Anya moves to a new town and gets mistaken for a woman named Sarah, she soon discovers she has an identical twin sister who was separated at birth. However, when Anya decides to investigate why, she's met with a mysterious threat.

title: Secret Life of a Good Wife
description: Jenna is an influencer with a traumatic past who finds peace, love and internet fame as a traditional housewife. When her mother goes missing, she soon realizes the kind and loving community she's come to rely on harbors dark secrets.

title: Here Kills the Bride
description: Jasmine finds out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. Jasmine investigates the reasons for the marriage and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

title: Don't Scream, It's Me
description: Fifteen years ago, Liz's ex-boyfriend, Drew, was caught robbing a bank. Now, he's in her backyard, asking her to hide him after a prison escape.

title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E07 — Someone Is Trying to Ruin My Life
